annotations.title: Record an ad platform offer claim

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Records the claim of one offer row (`claimId` = a row id from ads_offers_list): status, the date it was claimed, and notes. Owners and admins of the brand only. A record only: it never creates, turns on or funds an ad.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/ads/offers/{claimId}.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key.

claimedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD (or ISO timestamp); null clears it.

name: ads_offer_update
title: Record an ad platform offer claim
